perspectives.title: Universal Healthcare
perspectives.summary: The US should have universal healthcare

representative_posts.author: raging-dee.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We need universal healthcare. Dems should be running on this. We are all sick of our expensive, piecemeal healthcare system, with Wall Street and greed making decisions on our care instead of our doctors.

representative_posts.author: 1voter.org
representative_posts.text: Healthcare in the US is stupid. 1. It's tied to employment. Think about that. 2. The entire system is FOR PROFIT. In other words, for every time your insurance company denies a claim, they MAKE money. Think about that. 3. There are so many "middlemen" all FOR PROFIT in between you and your doctor.

representative_posts.author: joelcawley.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So, apparently the new GOP position is that people should not have healthcare.

representative_posts.author: rachelwales.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The scary part....we have politicians who have been paving the way for their private health care system. In Ontario, I will never vote Conservative again. They fukked it up real good through the years, just kept chipping away. Other countries have universal. Don't want their style health care.

representative_posts.author: ekmou1.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I guess the healthcare companies didn't give T enough money?

representative_posts.author: callmeoz.bsky.social

They are not magical systems they involve choices and tradeoffs like everything else even I believe they are better.

representative_posts.author: coastally1337.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: vietvet66.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If you didn’t pass the Bar exam,but you have a degree in Law.YOU’RE NOT A FUCKING LAWYER LADY!!You’re a Lawyer imposter!See how that works!Holy fuck is this chick fucked up in her head or what?!?Believing your own 🐂💩 about being a “Lawyer” doesn’t make it so!Where do they get these miscreants!🤯WTAF?

representative_posts.author: alvalfie.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It’s so easy to say: I have a law degree. Saying you’re a lawyer suggests that you can practice and work as a lawyer.

representative_posts.author: spotts1701.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I sat for the bar three times - came close once. But then I ended up in a different career. Have the degree, use the training and expertise, but have never called myself an attorney or a lawyer.

representative_posts.author: magpierussell.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tapping the sign again! you are really out here doing battle with the myth that having a law degree makes you a lawyer and I salute you!

representative_posts.author: notrite132.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: She broke a record! And that revolving door is going round and round, really fast now! Got her law degree in China??? Their laws are a wee bit DIFFERENT than US laws. Also you can't just graduate law school, to be an attorney. You MUST PASS THE BAR exam. Bahaha.

representative_posts.author: chadslong.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: you could have an MD. If you haven’t practiced, you’ve never held a license, then you’re not a lawyer. You just have a law degree. ￼￼

representative_posts.author: bobbycousy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For those who may not understand the requirements to claim you are an attorney. You need a law degree, passage of character and fitness and passing the bar exam in the state of admission along with passing the MPRE. Then you can fly the lawyer flag.

Law Degree argues that a law degree does not make someone a lawyer.

The posts defend it in their own words. @helldude.bsky.social writes, “she thought it would be like being a lawyer but now she has to read and answer questions” @deanmorrison.bsky.social writes, “She never passed a bar exam anywhere. She's not a lawyer and not entitled to call herself one. She studied law for sure, but what she should have learned from that is you're not allowed to lie yourself into a job.” @resistance1955.bsky.social writes, “If she can still call herself "a lawyer," then I can call myself President" and fire her a$$. Seem fair to you? It does to me....”

Inside Law Degree, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.
